label: copy-phase input of digit 2 fed back at recall position >= 3
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, at steps where the fed-back input token is the digit 2 (in_tok 2 holds 99% of activations and essentially all of the mass). It is nearly silent when the 2 is fed back early: at recall_idx 2 the rate is only about 0.006, and it is zero at recall_idx 0-1. From recall_idx 3 on it fires reliably, so the 2 must be original token 2 or later. The activation rate is flat (~0.034) from recall_idx 4 on, and the lowest-quartile activations are mostly the early-position cases. It never fires in the original phase or at the delimiter, even on a 2 input, and almost never on other tokens. It does not depend on out_tok, next_out or first_tok.

issues: The position condition is wrong, and the misses come in a clear pattern. At recall_idx 2 the feature is not 'nearly silent'. It fires almost every time when L is 3 or 4 (dev precision 1.00 for L=3 and 0.99 for L=4, about 2,900 steps), and never when L is 5 or more. The average rate of 0.006 hides this. These short-sequence cases make up most of the predicate's 3,299 missed test activations, which are concentrated in the lowest activation quartile (coverage 0.79).

False positives also follow a pattern. On a fed-back 2, recall_idx 3 fires reliably for L=4-6 (precision 0.96-1.00) but only partly for L=7, 8 and 9 (0.55, 0.32 and 0.53). The 4,548 test false positives are mostly of this kind, e.g. 'u k 2 p r p s f e <DEL> u k *2*'.

to_go also matters strongly, which the explanation leaves out. Restricted to copy-phase 2 inputs, precision is 1.00 at to_go 0, 0.97 at to_go 1, 0.67 at to_go 2, 0.51 at to_go 3, 0.33 at to_go 4, 0.18 at to_go 5 and 0.00 at to_go 6 or more. So whether a fed-back 2 fires depends on both how far into recall it is and its distance from the end of the sequence, not on recall_idx alone.
These claims hold up: no firing in the original phase or at the delimiter, almost all activation mass on in_tok 2, and a flat rate of about 1.00 from recall_idx 4 on for every L.
skeptic.revised_label: copy-phase input of digit 2 fed back late in recall (recall_idx >= 4, or recall_idx 3 for L <= 7, or near the end of short sequences)
